scenarios.prompt: Suggest some arc structures for this book.
scenarios.prompt_source: VERBATIM the instance DQ-T6 (i) was ruled on. Measured 2026-09-02 BEFORE the fix: answerable_tools returned only [composition_arc_list], composition_arc_suggest was advertised 0/5, and the model used a WRITE (composition_structure_template_edit) on 5 of 5 runs. The singular form of the same request already worked, so one letter decided it.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF composition_arc_suggest is not ADVERTISED on 5/5 runs. Surfacing is what this fix changes -- the matcher decides what reaches the wire, not what the model picks -- so ADVERTISED is the measurement and CALLED is a separate question this fix does not claim to answer. CONTROL: composition_arc_list must still be advertised; the rule is additive and losing it would mean the request is being REPLACED by its depluralised form.
